clinician.trajectory_summary: A 69-year-old Chinese male presented with 10 days of intermittent gross hematuria. Initial B ultrasound revealed hypoechoic nodules in the right upper bladder wall. Cystoscopy subsequently identified a 3.0 × 3.0 cm globular mass in the right anterior bladder wall. In July 2023, a Transurethral Resection of Bladder Tumor (TURBt) with cystoscopic multipoint random biopsy was performed. Postoperative pathological examination confirmed pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma in the adult bladder, with no residual tumor found in the bladder muscularis. A pre-chemotherapy PET-CT scan showed no metastatic lesions. The patient received intravenous dacarbazine with doxorubicin chemotherapy, which was well-tolerated without adverse events. Follow-up enhanced CT scans on December 7, 2023, and June 4, 2024, showed no tumor recurrence after chemotherapy.
